lesson.pre_a1_modelo: Can I try it on, please?

listenings.text: Good afternoon, shoppers, and welcome to Dolphin Mall. Can I have your attention, please? Today all dresses are twenty percent off. The fitting rooms are on the second floor. The mall is open until nine p.m. Thank you, and happy shopping!

Hi, I am Kevin. I work at a clothes store in Miami. Many tourists in my store are from Brazil. Their questions are always the same. Can I try this on? Can I have a large? Can I pay by card? And my answer is always the same too: Yes, of course!

extra_audio.text: Kevin says: Can I help you? Eliane says: Can I try it on? The dress is too small. Eliane says: Can I have a large? Eliane says: Can I pay by card?
